title: Classify a complaint safely
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: As Customer Service Agent, classify this product concern without echoing personal information or sending a response.

answer.question: As Customer Service Agent, classify this product concern without echoing personal information or sending a response.
